title: Hot updates while you edit
summary: A hot update changes the open page while you edit. A stylesheet update keeps the page state. A supported service update stops the service and starts it again. The service gets back the state that it chooses to keep. Other changes can need a full page reload. A failed build keeps the last good page and shows a diagnostic overlay (error messages on top of the page) with the file, the line and help. The preview never stops because of a problem in your files: a project that is broken at start gets an error page until a save fixes it.
